name: MonarchFileCard
title: FileCard
summary: One file as a card or a row: a picture or the type icon, the name, the type and size, optional badges, an optional selection checkbox and an optional place for actions.
whenToUse: In a grid or list of files where people open, select and act on files: documents, attachments, uploads that have finished.
whenNotToUse: For a file attached to a message or form, use MonarchAttachmentChip. For uploads in progress, use MonarchUploadQueue. To show the file's contents, use MonarchFilePreview.
api: @Composable fun MonarchFileCard(name: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, sizeBytes: Long? = null, contentType: String? = null, meta: String? = null, image: Painter? = null, badges: List<String> = emptyList(), layout: MonarchFileCardLayout = MonarchFileCardLayout.Card, selected: Boolean = false, onSelectedChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, enabled: Boolean = true, onOpen: (() -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchFileCardLabels = MonarchFileCardLabels(), interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null, actions: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)
class MonarchFileCardLabels(select: ((name: String) -> String)? = null, type: String? = null)

options.name: name
options.description: The file name with its extension. Two lines in a card, cut at the end; one line in a row, cut in the middle so the extension stays visible.

options.name: sizeBytes
options.description: The size in bytes, shown in the locale's file units with Formatter.formatShortFileSize, such as "2.4 MB".

options.name: contentType
options.description: The MIME type. With the name it decides the type icon and the type in the meta line.

options.name: meta
options.description: More text after the size, already localised, such as "Edited yesterday" or an owner.

options.name: image
options.description: A preview the app has loaded. While it is null (none, loading or failed) the type icon is shown on a tinted tile.

options.name: badges
options.description: Short states shown as neutral MonarchBadges under the name, such as "Shared".

options.name: layout
options.description: Card: a 4:3 preview above the name, for grids. Row: a 40dp preview beside the name, for lists.

options.name: selected
options.description: Whether the file is selected. Shown only with onSelectedChange.

options.name: onSelectedChange
options.description: Shows a selection checkbox: at the top start corner of a card, at the start of a row.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the file can be opened and selected. The app disables its own actions.

options.name: onOpen
options.description: Opens the file. Makes the picture, name and meta one button with a pressed state.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the checkbox's TalkBack name and the type in the meta line.

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The source of the press and focus interactions of the open area.

options.name: actions
options.description: The file's actions, such as a MonarchIconButton that opens a MonarchMenu, at the top end corner of a card or the end of a row.

states.name: rest
states.description: The surface background with a subtle border.

states.name: pressed
states.description: With onOpen: the subtle background and the default border, with a ripple.

states.name: selected
states.description: The checkbox is ticked; the card has the accent subtle background and a 2dp accent border.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The subtle background, disabled text colors, and the open area and checkbox cannot be used.

states.name: no picture or failed picture
states.description: The file type icon on a subtle tile.

appearance: A Surface in the surface background role with a subtle border and the large radius (medium in a row). The name is strong body text, the meta line muted caption text, the placeholder the subtle background with the file type icon's muted tile. Selected uses the accent subtle and accent border roles. The same roles in every theme, including both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web's href becomes onOpen: the app opens the file itself, for example with an ACTION_VIEW intent. The web's actions slot stays a slot, because Monarch bundles no icons for a menu trigger; iOS draws an ellipsis Menu from its menu items instead. The web reports Shift for range selection; Android has no Shift-click on touch, so range selection belongs to the app. Badges are strings shown as neutral MonarchBadges instead of free content. The size parameter is sizeBytes, as in MonarchAttachmentChip, because size names the size option of other components. The picture is a Painter the app loads (Monarch adds no image loader), where iOS takes an Image or a URL; iOS isSelected as a binding is selected with onSelectedChange.
accessibility: The picture, name, meta line and badges are one merged element that reads the name, then the type, size, meta and badges; with onOpen it is a button.
The checkbox is a MonarchCheckbox named "Select" and the file name, read with its checked state, with a 48dp touch target.
The actions are separate elements; name an icon-only trigger after the file ("Actions for Q3 report.pdf").
Selection is shown by the check mark and a thicker border as well as color.
The picture and the type icon are hidden from TalkBack, because the meta line already says the type.
edgeCases: Long names take two lines in a card and are cut at the end; in a row they take one line and are cut in the middle.
A picture that fails to load is passed as null and shows the type icon; it is not an error state.
Without onOpen the card is not a button but is still one element for TalkBack.
A blank meta is left out of the meta line.
